strict_title_evidentiary_rule.in_scope_criterion: Frozen title must explicitly prove BOTH: (a) lithium-ion cell or pack chemistry/domain AND (b) cycling/aging/degradation dataset
strict_title_evidentiary_rule.insufficient_metadata_criterion: Title specifies lithium-ion or battery but does not prove both conditions from frozen text alone (no unverified external inferences permitted)
strict_title_evidentiary_rule.out_of_scope_criterion: Non-lithium chemistry, non-cell/pack material studies, non-cycling datasets, or non-battery domains

deterministic_selection_algorithm.ranking: ascending lexicographical by selection_score over the 3 IN_SCOPE entries
deterministic_selection_algorithm.selection: Top-ranked entry in candidates TSV (10.1038/s41597-024-03831-x) becomes CONFIRMATORY_HIGH_DOC_CONTROL upon freeze ratification

blindness_invariant: Dataset repository contents, time-series data files, and README assets of the selected candidate DOI remain strictly unopened prior to execution.
